public abstract class ThreadedModule extends Module
A module with work that must not run on the game thread: network calls, file scans, anything that would otherwise stutter the frame.

The background task starts when the module is enabled and is cancelled when it is disabled, so a subclass only implements runInBackground() and never touches an executor.

The task runs off-thread, so treat any game state it reads as a snapshot and push results back through a field the game-thread handlers read.

    • runInBackground

      protected abstract void runInBackground()
      The background body.

      Loop here if the work is continuous, and honour interruption: while (!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) { ... }. Returning ends the task until the next enable.
